citations: https://openfga.dev/docs/modeling/conditions (conditions on tuples; why the decision policies are not expressible)
notes: not expressible: a Check returns one boolean for one relation; the policy needs 4 distinct outcomes (allow, observe, deny, escalate_human) selected by ordered first match rules. Conditions on tuples could gate a single allow relation on the request context, which is the Phase 5 combination test, not a translation.
